_comment: A film preset. convert.cube renders Apple Log straight through a stock baked from spektrafilm
(luts/film/CHANGELOG.txt), so tone is neutral: a curve on top would bend the
stock's own. Each clip's exposure and white balance are metered in linear before the cube
(scripts/solve-exposure.py) against match.reference_stops; correct.* still adds on top.
Portra 800 on 35mm, a lab scan: +1 stop, more contrast and colour than 160. The fastest
Portra, so the grain is coarse and shows most in the thin shadows. Stills stocks carry an
anti-halation layer, so the glow is slight.
name: Portra 800
